title: RunNext
description: Deterministic next-action hint from solidsdd-next (read-only; does not mutate run-state).

action.description: Canonical next action id (e.g. critique_change_brief, loop_wave, human_gate, done).

skill.description: Skill id to invoke when applicable (e.g. solidsdd-critique).

subject.description: Critique subject when skill is solidsdd-critique.

item_ids.description: WorkPlan item ids for wave actions.

inputs.description: Relative paths the parent should pass into the next Task.

legal_actions.description: Actions accepted by validate --declared for this state (includes primary action).
